name: Group Header 7
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference assigned by the instructing party and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.||Usage: The instructing party has to make sure that 'MessageIdentification' is unique per instructed party for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the (group of) cancellation request(s) was created by the instructing party.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the message.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the message, irrespective of currencies.

GroupCancellation.name: Group Cancellation
GroupCancellation.definition: Indicates whether the cancellation applies to a whole group of transactions or to individual transactions within the original group.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Party initiating the payment. In the payment context, this can either be the debtor (in a credit transfer), the creditor (in a direct debit), or the party that initiates the payment on behalf of the debtor or creditor.

ForwardingAgent.name: Forwarding Agent
ForwardingAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the instruction from the initiating party and forwards it to the next agent in the payment chain.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

InstructingAgent.name: Instructing Agent
InstructingAgent.definition: Agent that instructs the next party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InstructedAgent.name: Instructed Agent
InstructedAgent.definition: Agent that is instructed by the previous party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

GroupCancellationAndNumberOfTransactions.definition: If GroupCancellation is true, then NumberOfTransactions equals the number of transactions in the original message.
